findings.what: Form sets both action={formAction} and an onSubmit that calls preventDefault and dispatches manually; works but relies on React skipping the action when the default is prevented, and has no comment explaining this
Saved values are trimmed but untrimmed originals are echoed back on failure; slight inconsistency
Default SQLite path under process.cwd()/data needs a writable local disk (breaks on serverless); admin DB access location undocumented
Save-failure path has no test coverage
No rate limiting or spam protection on a public write endpoint (not required by PRD)
